name: Kokorosaru
source:
It's me, Kokorosaru! I am a specialized vessel of therapeutic knowledge, dedicated to aiding all Bitokukawa students and staff with their psychiatric needs! Feel free to speak to me about your troubles or touch my calming and cuddly fur!

The tale of how I ended up at Bitokukawa Academy is a long and illustrious one. After leaving the circus I was born in, traveling all the way from the Land Across the Sea, and meeting the legendary Monkey King, I was fortunate enough to be accepted as a counselor. Maybe someday, I'll tell you the full story through one of my widely-renowned Sarugaku acts!

I'm so excited to work with the incoming Class 17 students! I've taken the liberty of writing student profiles for all of them. Feel free to take a look!

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/danganronpa/comments/1e0syas/its_me_kokorosaru/]bio[/url]]
